checks.check: Required routes exist and route mapping matches current implementation.
Typography, colors, spacing and radii match the locked system.
Relevant UX4G foundations/components/patterns are used or consciously reproduced with provenance.
Relevant GIGW Quality/Accessibility requirements are represented and tested where applicable.
User goal, next action, state, ownership and recovery are clear.
Visible focus, keyboard interaction, semantic labels and non-color-only status.
Primary pages work at mobile, tablet and desktop widths.
Deterministic mock data remains the single synthetic source.
No real EPFO transaction/backend claim is implied.
Running UI is inspected when browser tooling is available.

release_gate: No task is complete if a critical check fails or if a skipped check is reported as passed.
